checks.name: default_help_lists_v2_commands
checks.detail:
usage: native_engagement.py [-h] {run,resume,status} ...

Drive one scope-only native engagement through the existing phase commands.
The signed scope and each phase command decide authority. This file only
orders the commands and records enough state to refuse an uncertain repeat
after loss of the driver. ``resume`` re-reads durable phase receipts; it never
clears an unknown model or Docker effect.

positional arguments:
  {run,resume,status}
    run                begin one scope-only engagement
    resume             continue one durable engagement
    status             read the driver phase without dispatch

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
